description: Na₂MgGe₂(SbO₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.74 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two SbO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-53°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.14 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SbO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-63°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.83 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-66°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.21 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.54 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two Sb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONaMgGeSb tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgGeSb trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgGeSb trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mg, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, one Ge, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₂MgGeSb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONaMgGeSb tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, one Ge, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONaMgGeSb tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgGeSb trigonal bipyramids and corners with two equivalent ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramids.
